about: Seasonal banner on the home page (scripts/pages27.py). A festival shows from 'start' to 'end' inclusive (Europe/London dates). Preview any festival with ?festive=<id> (e.g. ?festive=diwali) and any day with ?date=YYYY-MM-DD. Only add dates checked against a reliable source.
